report_level_evaluation.results: Connections graph1718nodes,diameter10,mean degree7 rendered in browser. Author reports browsers can render10000nodes at at least24FPS with efficient processing;no hardware/browser test matrix provided.; limits: No participant study or comparator;semantic/geographic/time filtering and larger-graph clustering are future work.
